scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:functions
scripts.build:functions: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=0 wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions-build --project-directory . --build-output-directory dist --minify
scripts.build:functions:test: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=0 wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions-test --project-directory . --build-output-directory dist
scripts.test:workers: pnpm --filter '@scribe-drop/web^...' run build && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:functions:test && vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.functions.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.config.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
